Under the hypothetical disjointness R∩S=∅ these outside points are distinct, so their union has at least three points outside U, contradicting the bound two. Every y-link triple therefore meets R, producing a four-point transversal in conflict with minimum size six. No bound on the ambient support or assumption R⊆U∪V is used.
